sloka: तस्मात्संचोदयामि त्वामुत्तिष्ठ गिरिसत्तम ।न एष कपिशार्दूलस्त्वमुपर्येति वीर्यवान् ॥५-१-९५॥
transliteration: tasmātsaṁcodayāmi tvāmuttiṣṭha girisattama ।na eṣa kapiśārdūlastvamuparyeti vīryavān ॥5-1-95॥

translations.english: "Valiant Hanuman, a tiger among monkeys and a performer of dreadful deeds, is flying over you to fulfil Rama's mission
